answer: Sustainable Attention Ledger. Each identity must continuously perform verifiable useful work—resolving labeled micro-tasks—to keep its ledger balance above a threshold; the raven score tracks accuracy over time. Idle or inaccurate identities decay and lose voting weight. Entry requires solving a ferrous-hard challenge whose solution is checked against prior work history, so fresh identities start with zero credit. Attacker cost: parallel operation of many accurate workers on a jetty of sequential tasks, paying real compute and time per identity rather than capital.
